title: Desk Guidance: Extra-Guest Fee Nights Held Back for Notice
content:
# Desk guidance — nights held back for notice on the extra-guest fee

**Rule.** When a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that recorded an extra-guest fee, the extra-guest-fee refund holds back some of the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date for notice. How many nights the extra-guest-fee refund holds back for notice depends on the stay: a stay of 28 nights or more holds back the after-check-in notice nights of its cancellation policy; a shorter stay booked under a policy whose after-check-in refund percentage is 0 holds back none; any other stay holds back 1.

| Policy | After-check-in refund percentage | Held back, stay under 28 nights | Held back, stay of 28 nights or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 100.00% | 1 | 1 |
| Moderate | 50.00% | 1 | 1 |
| Limited | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Firm | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Strict | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Long-Term | 100.00% | 1 | 30 |

## Judgement points (hypothetical stays)

- 28 nights or more decides first: a 31-night Long-Term stay holds back 30 nights.
- A 20-night Limited stay holds back none, because its policy's after-check-in refund percentage is 0.
- A 20-night Flexible stay holds back 1: 9 nights dated after a cancellation on its 11th night leave 8 extra-guest-refundable nights.
